title: Amazon S3
text:
Amazon S3 is an object storage service.

S3 Standard is designed for 99.999999999% durability of objects across multiple Availability Zones.

S3 Glacier Deep Archive is the lowest-cost storage class, intended for data accessed once or twice a year with retrieval within 12 hours.

title: AWS Lambda
text:
AWS Lambda runs code without provisioning servers.

A Lambda function can run for at most 15 minutes per invocation.

Memory can be configured between 128 MB and 10,240 MB, and CPU scales proportionally with memory.

title: Amazon Bedrock
text:
Amazon Bedrock offers foundation models through a single API.

Knowledge Bases for Bedrock implement retrieval augmented generation by chunking documents, embedding them and storing vectors.

The Rerank API reorders retrieved passages by relevance to a query using a reranker model.
